"Hold On" is a song by Canadian pop singer Justin Bieber, featured on his sixth studio album "Justice," which was released in 2021. The song was written by Bieber, Poo Bear (Jason Boyd), Giveon, and Harv. It features vocals from American R&B singer Giveon. 

The track is a mid-tempo pop and R&B song that discusses perseverance and staying strong through difficult times. It was released as a single from the album and received moderate commercial success.

The song appears on the album "Justice," which was released on March 19, 2021. The album explores themes of love, healing, and social justice.
